verses.text: It is a good thing to give thanks unto Jehovah, And to sing praises unto thy name, O Most High;

segments.text: It is a good thing to give thanks unto Jehovah,
And to sing praises unto thy name, O Most High;

verses.text: To show forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, And thy faithfulness every night,

segments.text: To show forth thy lovingkindness in the morning,
And thy faithfulness every night,

verses.text: With an instrument of ten strings, and with the psaltery; With a solemn sound upon the harp.

segments.text: With an instrument of ten strings, and with the psaltery;
With a solemn sound upon the harp.

verses.text: For thou, Jehovah, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.

segments.text: For thou, Jehovah, hast made me glad through thy work:
I will triumph in the works of thy hands.

verses.text: How great are thy works, O Jehovah! Thy thoughts are very deep.

segments.text: How great are thy works, O Jehovah!
Thy thoughts are very deep.

verses.text: A brutish man knoweth not; Neither doth a fool understand this:

segments.text: A brutish man knoweth not;
Neither doth a fool understand this:

verses.text: When the wicked spring as the grass, And when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; It is that they shall be destroyed for ever.

segments.text: When the wicked spring as the grass,
And when all the workers of iniquity do flourish;
It is that they shall be destroyed for ever.

verses.text: But thou, O Jehovah, art on high for evermore.

segments.text: But thou, O Jehovah, art on high for evermore.

verses.text: For, lo, thine enemies, O Jehovah, For, lo, thine enemies shall perish; All the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

segments.text: For, lo, thine enemies, O Jehovah,
For, lo, thine enemies shall perish;
All the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

verses.text: But my horn hast thou exalted like the horn of the wild-ox: I am anointed with fresh oil.

segments.text: But my horn hast thou exalted like
the horn of
the wild-ox:
I am anointed with fresh oil.

verses.text: Mine eye also hath seen my desire on mine enemies, Mine ears have heard my desire of the evil-doers that rise up against me.

segments.text: Mine eye also hath seen
my desire
on mine enemies,
Mine ears have heard
my desire
of the evil-doers that rise up against me.

verses.text: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree: He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

segments.text: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree:
He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

verses.text: They are planted in the house of Jehovah; They shall flourish in the courts of our God.

segments.text: They are planted in the house of Jehovah;
They shall flourish in the courts of our God.

verses.text: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; They shall be full of sap and green:

segments.text: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age;
They shall be full of sap and green:

verses.text: To show that Jehovah is upright; He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

segments.text: To show that Jehovah is upright;
He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

headings.text: A Psalm, a Song for the sabbath day.
